title: NullPointerException in UserService.findById
description: findById returns null when user does not exist in DB. Callers assume non-null return.
root_cause: UserRepository.findById returns Optional<User> but callers call .get() without checking isPresent().
resolution: Wrap with Optional.ifPresent() or use .orElseThrow(). Add null guard in UserService.findById before returning.

title: Database connection timeout during integration tests
description: Integration tests fail intermittently with connection timeout when connection pool is exhausted.
root_cause: Tests open DB connections but don't release them. Connection pool (max=5) gets exhausted after a few parallel test runs.
resolution: Annotate test class with @Transactional to auto-rollback, or close connections explicitly in @AfterEach. Increase pool size in test config.

title: AssertionError in PaymentService — amount rounding mismatch
description: Payment amount assertions fail due to floating-point precision differences.
root_cause: Double arithmetic introduces floating-point errors. assertEquals(expected, actual) fails for values like 10.005 vs 10.004999999.
resolution: Use BigDecimal for monetary values. Replace assertEquals with assertThat(...).isCloseTo(expected, within(0.01)).

title: Timeout in AuthService — token validation too slow
description: Token validation tests time out when running against a real JWT with RSA-4096 keys.
root_cause: RSA-4096 key generation in @BeforeEach runs on every test case. Key generation takes ~800ms per test.
resolution: Move key generation to @BeforeAll (static). Cache the KeyPair across tests. Use RSA-2048 for test environments.

title: IndexOutOfBoundsException in OrderProcessor
description: OrderProcessor fails when processing an empty order list.
root_cause: Code accesses orders.get(0) without checking if the list is empty. Empty orders passed from upstream mock.
resolution: Add isEmpty() guard before accessing list elements. Update mock to reflect realistic non-empty input or handle empty case explicitly.

title: ConcurrentModificationException in CacheManager
description: Cache eviction tests fail with ConcurrentModificationException during iteration.
root_cause: Test thread modifies HashMap while another thread iterates it during eviction. HashMap is not thread-safe.
resolution: Replace HashMap with ConcurrentHashMap. Use iterator.remove() for safe removal during iteration.
fix_snippet: private final Map<String, Object> cache = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

title: StackOverflowError in RecursiveParser
description: Parser tests fail with StackOverflowError on deeply nested JSON input.
root_cause: Recursive parse() method has no depth limit. Deeply nested test fixtures (depth > 500) exhaust the JVM stack.
resolution: Add a maxDepth parameter. Throw ParseException when depth exceeds threshold. Use iterative parsing with an explicit stack for deep structures.
fix_snippet: if (depth > MAX_DEPTH) throw new ParseException("Max nesting depth exceeded: " + MAX_DEPTH);

title: FileNotFoundException in ReportGenerator
description: Report generation tests fail because the output directory doesn't exist.
root_cause: ReportGenerator assumes /reports/ directory exists. In CI, the directory is not pre-created.
resolution: Add Files.createDirectories(outputPath.getParent()) before writing. Alternatively, create the directory in CI pipeline setup.

title: ClassCastException in PluginLoader
description: Plugin loading fails when a plugin JAR was compiled against a different interface version.
root_cause: PluginInterface was updated (new method added) but plugin JAR was not recompiled. ClassLoader loads the old class.
resolution: Add version check on plugin load. Enforce interface version compatibility. Recompile all plugins after interface changes.

title: HTTP 500 in NotificationService — SMTP connection refused
description: Notification tests fail because the test environment has no SMTP server running.
root_cause: NotificationService tries to connect to real SMTP (localhost:25) in tests. No mock is configured.
resolution: Mock the JavaMailSender or use GreenMail for integration tests. Profile-separate SMTP config so tests use a mock sender.

title: ModuleNotFoundError in CI: dependency missing from the test environment
description: pytest fails at collection with ImportError while importing test module and ModuleNotFoundError: No module named. The package works locally but is not installed on the CI runner.
root_cause: The dependency is missing from the requirements or lock file, is an optional extra that CI does not install, or the runner uses a different Python version than local development.
resolution: Add the package to the test requirements or install the extra. Pin versions in a lock file and make CI install from it. Check the Python version matrix.

title: NoClassDefFoundError: conflicting JUnit or library jar versions on the classpath
description: JUnitException: The wrapped NoClassDefFoundError is likely caused by the versions of JUnit jars on the classpath. The following conflicting versions were detected.
root_cause: Two modules resolve different versions of the same library, for example an old junit-platform-commons next to newer engine and launcher artifacts, so classes from one version call classes missing in another.
resolution: Align all modules of the library to one version using a BOM or dependencyManagement. Run the dependency tree task to find the stray version and exclude or upgrade it.

title: ImportError: cannot import name from partially initialized module
description: ImportError: cannot import name from partially initialized module (most likely due to a circular import), or a test file shadows an installed package name.
root_cause: Two modules import each other at import time, or a local file named like a library hides the real package.
resolution: Move the import inside the function that needs it, extract shared code into a third module, or rename the shadowing file.
fix_snippet: def build(): from pkg.helpers import make  # import lazily to break the cycle

title: Compilation error on a newer or different JDK: cannot find symbol
description: compileJava FAILED with error: cannot find symbol, symbol: method X, location: variable of type Y. The build passes on one JDK or vendor and fails on another entry of a cross-version matrix.
root_cause: The code or a build tool uses an API that exists only in some JDK versions or vendors, or a library whose API changed between versions.
resolution: Compile against the lowest supported JDK, guard version-specific APIs behind a compatibility layer, or exclude the tool task from the failing matrix entry.

title: TypeScript compile error after a dependency upgrade (TS2345, TS2322)
description: error TS2345: Argument of type X is not assignable to parameter of type Y, appearing in CI after a types package or compiler upgrade.
root_cause: Type definitions changed in a minor release, or the lock file resolves a newer types version in CI than locally.
resolution: Pin the types package version, update call sites to the new signature, and commit the lock file so CI and local resolve identical versions.

title: SyntaxError on an older runtime: language feature not supported
description: SyntaxError: invalid syntax on one CI matrix entry that runs an older Python (match statements) or an older Node (optional chaining).
root_cause: The source uses syntax that is newer than the oldest runtime in the CI matrix.
resolution: Raise the minimum supported version in the project metadata, drop the old matrix entry, or rewrite the code with older syntax.

title: AssertionFailedError on macOS or Windows: path comparison differs by platform
description: expected: /var/folders/.../file but was: /private/var/folders/.../file on macOS, or backslash paths and drive letters on Windows break string comparisons of paths.
root_cause: macOS temp directories are symlinks (/var points to /private/var) and Windows uses different separators, so string comparison fails although both paths name the same file.
resolution: Compare canonical paths (toRealPath) or Path objects instead of strings, and avoid hard-coded separators in expected values.

title: Snapshot or golden-file mismatch after an intentional output change
description: Jest or pytest snapshot test fails: snapshot name mismatched, received value does not match stored snapshot.
root_cause: Rendered output or serialised data changed on purpose or through a dependency upgrade, but the stored snapshot was not updated.
resolution: Review the diff. If the change is intended update the snapshot and commit it; otherwise fix the regression that changed the output.

title: Intermittent failure from a test teardown race: runner already closed
description: Error: Vite module runner has been closed, or transport was disconnected, cannot call fetchModule. Fails only sometimes, usually at the end of a test file.
root_cause: An async operation still runs after the test environment is torn down. The test does not await it, or the server closes before pending requests finish.
resolution: Await all pending promises before teardown, close servers in afterAll after in-flight work completes, and only then consider a retry.

title: Test timeout on a slow CI runner or a hanging subprocess
description: pexpect.exceptions.TIMEOUT: Timeout exceeded, or Test timed out after N ms. The same test passes locally.
root_cause: CI runners are slower and shared, or a subprocess or interactive prompt never produces the expected output so the wait hits its limit.
resolution: Increase the timeout on CI, wait for a condition instead of sleeping, and capture subprocess output to see where it stalls.

title: Gradle test worker lost: MessageIOException Could not write
description: Unexpected exception thrown. org.gradle.internal.remote.internal.MessageIOException: Could not write to a local socket, followed by a Test task FAILED.
root_cause: The forked test JVM died, usually from running out of memory or being killed by the runner, so Gradle lost its connection to the worker.
resolution: Raise the test JVM heap, reduce test parallelism, look for runaway memory in the failing module, and check the worker crash output.

title: Corrupted download or cache: unexpected EOF while fetching a package
description: Error: unexpected EOF while unzipping a downloaded package, or failed to fetch a package archive from a registry during install.
root_cause: A transient network failure truncated the download, or the build cache contains a partial archive.
resolution: Clear the cache and retry, add retries to the install step, and mirror critical packages if the registry is unreliable.

title: ValueError after a library upgrade: parameter or behaviour changed
description: ValueError: You must set either alpha or the deprecated C, or array indexing is only allowed when arrays have matching shapes, raised after upgrading numpy or scikit-learn.
root_cause: The library changed an argument or removed a deprecated option, and the test or code still uses the old call.
resolution: Read the library changelog, update the call to the new parameter, and pin an upper version bound until the code is migrated.
fix_snippet: model = Lasso(alpha=1.0)  # use the new parameter name

title: Missing environment variable or secret on CI, especially for pull requests from forks
description: KeyError for an API token, environment variable not set, 401 Unauthorized or Permission denied, only on CI.
root_cause: Secrets are not exposed to workflows triggered by forks, or the variable is defined locally but missing in the CI configuration.
resolution: Define the variable in the CI settings, skip or mock tests that need secrets on forks, and fail early with a clear message.

title: AttributeError: NoneType object has no attribute
description: AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute raised in a test because a function returned None unexpectedly.
root_cause: A lookup, regex match or API call returned None and the result was used without a check, often because a mock or fixture is incomplete.
resolution: Check the value before use, make the function raise a clear error, and fix the mock or fixture that returns None.
fix_snippet: match = pattern.search(text); assert match is not None, 'pattern did not match'

title: Runner out of memory or disk: MemoryError, heap out of memory, No space left on device
description: FATAL ERROR: JavaScript heap out of memory, java.lang.OutOfMemoryError, MemoryError or No space left on device on the CI runner.
root_cause: The test suite or build exceeds the runner's memory or disk, often from large fixtures, unbounded caches or leftover build artifacts.
resolution: Increase the heap, split the suite, clean caches between jobs, and use smaller fixtures.
